name: std::common_type<std::chrono::duration>
intro: Exposes the type named type, which is the common type of two std::chrono::durations, whose period is the greatest common divisor of Period1 and Period2.

sections.title: Member types
sections.text:
Member type

 Definition




 type

 std::chrono::duration<typename std::common_type<Rep1, Rep2>::type, /* see note */>

sections.title: Note
sections.text: The period of the resulting duration can be computed by forming a ratio of the greatest common divisor of Period1::num and Period2::num and the least common multiple of Period1::den and Period2::den.
